subject: Renewal QBR + roadmap demo — locking dates and procurement timeline
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@celerityhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Joe Alvarez <joe.alvarez@celerityhealth.com>, Celerity Health Procurement <procurement@celerityhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + roadmap demo — request to lock dates

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the pilot last quarter — our execs were impressed and want a combined Renewal QBR + roadmap demo to align product and procurement timelines. Rough asks from our side:

- Target week: second week of August (pref Mon/Tue morning PT)
- Exec slot required (VP+), technical deep-dive for engineering leads
- Procurement needs the SOW and estimated PO amount to start internal approvals (they said ~10 business days)

I attached a one-pager with our renewal summary and current contract notes. Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood can provide a final SOW + DocuSign link by 6 Aug? Our procurement has a hard freeze after 9 Aug due to internal budget cycles.

Elaine
Elaine Park
Director, Strategic Programs | Celerity Health
elaine@celerityhealth.com

Attachment: Celerity_Renewal_Summary.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@celerityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + roadmap demo — request to lock dates

Hi Elaine — thanks for the context and the attachment. Happy to run the combined QBR + roadmap demo. A few quick notes and proposals so procurement can plan: 

- Proposed slots (PT): Tue 10 Aug 09:00–11:00 or Wed 11 Aug 08:30–10:00. Both include 20–30 minute exec briefing + 60 minute technical demo breakouts.
- We can deliver a final SOW and DocuSign envelope by EOD 06 Aug if you confirm which slot you prefer by EOD 02 Aug.
- I attached a draft QBR agenda (QBR_Agenda_draft_v1.pdf). Please call out any must-have items for the exec portion.

Internal: looping in Marissa (customer exec) for availability and Monica (renewals) to coordinate pricing and contract details.

Priyom Das
Sales Lead, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: QBR_Agenda_draft_v1.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@celerityhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + roadmap demo — request to lock dates

Thanks Priyom — quick availability check on execs:

- Our VP of Product can do Tue 10 Aug 09:00–09:40 PT but has to drop for a board call at 09:45.
- Suggest we compress the exec briefing to 35 minutes (key wins + ask) and move the technical deep-dive to parallel tracks immediately after (45–60 min).

Also flag: it may help to surface two SOW options in parallel — standard renewal and a trimmed expansion package (smaller starting commit, easier for procurement to approve quickly). Monica, can you prepare a short SOW variant we can send on 6 Aug if Elaine confirms?

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 14:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal window + roadmap demo — pricing and SOW cadence

Forwarding quick note from finance/ops: we can support a staged SOW (option A: full renewal, option B: expansion pilot with conversion clause). For procurement cadence: allow 7–10 business days for PO after SOW sent; DocuSign turnaround for our standard SOW is typically 24–48 hours once signed by Celerity.

Pricing concession idea: if they sign the full renewal before 15 Aug, we can include one months' credit on committed capacity as a one-time retention credit. That helps them hit internal budget thresholds.

HubSpot: https://hubspot.example/deal/CEL-2027-REN-0342

Karthik Iyer
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Park <elaine@celerityhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Joe Alvarez <joe.alvarez@celerityhealth.com>, Celerity Health Procurement <procurement@celerityhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + roadmap demo — locking dates and procurement timeline

Priyom / team — thank you for the options and the draft agenda. We’ll take Tue 10 Aug 09:00–11:00 PT but need the following by EOD Friday 6 Aug so procurement can finish approvals:

- Final SOW (signed-ready PDF)
- DocuSign envelope or direct signing link
- Firm PO amount (ballpark acceptable for routing)

Procurement note (copied): if the SOW and PO are not in hand by 06 Aug they will push the approval window until late August; internal budget freeze is strict. We would prefer the full renewal but can accept the expansion pilot SOW if that expedites sign-off.

Please confirm you can meet the 06 Aug SOW delivery commitment and share the DocuSign link once sent. Quoting the earlier thread below for context.

— forwarded message —
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window + roadmap demo — request to lock dates
To: Elaine Park <elaine@celerityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Attachment: SOW_Celerity_v2.docx

Elaine — confirmed, we will aim to deliver the SOW and DocuSign link by 06 Aug. Monica will circulate the two SOW variants (A/B) and I will follow up with the DocuSign envelope once Finance clears pricing.

Elaine Park
Director, Strategic Programs | Celerity Health

Attachment: Celerity_Renewal_Summary.xlsx
